title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state whether the postcard will be readable with an electron microscope.

title: Planar Magnification Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the planar magnification needed for readability.

title: Linear Magnification Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the relationship between planar and linear magnification.

title: Electron Microscope Capability
description: Important Criteria: The response should include the maximum linear magnification of an electron microscope.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units used in calculations are consistent and appropriate.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors in calculating magnification values.

title: Assumptions Clarification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may clarify any assumptions made regarding the size of the postcard or the content density.
